tank.name: Spray tank (1135.6 L) and tank lid
tank.desc: 300 US gal (1135.6 L) chemical tank. Check the tank straps for play daily. End of day: triple-rinse and neutralise the whole spray system (Toro bulletin 08-20); poor rinsing is the main cause of pump-head corrosion. Flush with clean water yearly. Drain valve is at the rear of the tank.

boomL.name: Left boom section
boomL.desc: Raised and lowered from the boom-section lift switch on the centre console; stores in the transport X position. Grease the boom hinges every 100 h and regrease any hinge that has been washed. Inspect the nylon pivot bushings at 400 h (oil lightly on refit). Check boom-hinge spring compression per the manual.

boomC.name: Centre boom section and transport cradle
boomC.desc: Centre section at the rear with the boom-transport cradle and lift cylinders. Grease the actuator-rod bearings at 400 h (No. 2 lithium) and inspect the clevis pins. Inspect all spray hoses and connections every 200 h.

boomR.name: Right boom section
boomR.desc: Raised and lowered from the boom-section lift switch on the centre console; stores in the transport X position. Grease the boom hinges every 100 h and after washing. Inspect the nylon pivot bushings at 400 h.

nozzles.name: Nozzle turrets, drip checks and tip strainers
nozzles.desc: Factory booms use Toro turret bodies (108-3725 LH single, 108-3726 RH single, 108-3727 double) with a 41003 drip-check diaphragm. The machine shipped without nozzles, so tips are the club's choice: confirm on the machine before ordering. Match strainer mesh to nozzle size (50 mesh 120-0699, 100 mesh 120-0698). Run a flow calibration whenever nozzles are changed.

freshwater.name: Fresh-water tank
freshwater.desc: On the ROPS behind the passenger seat. Clean water for washing chemical off skin and eyes: fill it with clean water before every spray job. Turn the spigot lever to open.

rops.name: ROPS (roll bar) and seat belts
rops.desc: Check the ROPS mounts and seat belts daily. Do not drill, weld or modify the ROPS.

seat.name: Operator and passenger seats
seat.desc: Operator seat on the left (steering side), passenger seat on the right in front of the fresh-water tank. Seat switch is an interlock.

console.name: Centre console and spray controls
console.desc: Spray-pump switch, master section switch, boom-section lift switches, agitation switch and the spray-pressure gauge. Engage the spray pump only at LOW IDLE to protect the pump drive. Calibrate the agitation bypass valve yearly (689 kPa / 100 psi). The dash pressure gauge was replaced on WO 1431 (Oct 2026).

steering.name: Steering wheel and column
steering.desc: Hydraulic steering cylinder on the front axle. Grease the steering cylinder (2 per rod end), steering rod and spindle pivots every 50 h with No. 2 lithium. Check front toe-in every 200 h: 0-3 mm.

hood.name: Front hood and work lights
hood.desc: Front cowl with the two work lights. Check the lights before going out in low light.

frame.name: Frame, front fenders and footboard
frame.desc: Grease all fittings immediately after every wash (No. 2 lithium). Brakes: if the pedal travels more than 25 mm before resistance, adjust.

fueltank.name: Fuel tank (45 L diesel)
fueltank.desc: Right side, just behind the front wheel. About 45 L of No. 2-D diesel (up to B20). Fill to 25 mm below the neck, never full. The in-tank filter is part of the fuel standpipe: replace it and drain and clean the tank every 400 h. No separate number found for the in-tank filter: quote the s/n to the dealer. Fuel sender 132-7619.

hydtank.name: Hydraulic tank and filters
hydtank.desc: Right side between the wheels. About 56 L system (about 53 L to refill after a drain) of Toro Premium All Season Hydraulic Fluid (ISO VG 46). Two filters: forward under the tank and rear on the frame. Replace both elements and the fluid every 400 h (s/n 403330615 is before the 403460001 break, so the later 1000/2000 h intervals do not apply). Oil the gasket, hand tight plus 1/2 turn, run 3-5 min and recheck. Milky or black fluid: have the dealer flush the system.

tyreFL.name: Front tyre and wheel, left
tyreFL.desc: Smooth turf tyre, 138 kPa (20 psi). Front lug nuts 75-102 N.m (check at 100 h). Pack the front wheel bearings every 400 h. Tyre options can differ: check the machine before ordering.

tyreFR.name: Front tyre and wheel, right
tyreFR.desc: Smooth turf tyre, 138 kPa (20 psi). Front lug nuts 75-102 N.m (check at 100 h). Pack the front wheel bearings every 400 h. Tyre options can differ: check the machine before ordering.

tyreRL.name: Rear tyre and wheel, left
tyreRL.desc: Drive wheel on a planetary gearbox. 138 kPa (20 psi). Rear lug nuts 95-122 N.m (check at 100 h). Gearbox oil SAE 85W-140 to the lower hole every 400 h.

tyreRR.name: Rear tyre and wheel, right
tyreRR.desc: Drive wheel on a planetary gearbox. 138 kPa (20 psi). Rear lug nuts 95-122 N.m (check at 100 h). Gearbox oil SAE 85W-140 to the lower hole every 400 h.

engine.name: Engine: Kubota V1505-E3B 4-cyl diesel
engine.desc: 1498 cc water-cooled diesel (Toro engine part 132-5205), 12 V with a 60 A alternator. Oil 4.6 L API CH-4/CI-4 SAE 15W-40. Change oil and filter every 150 h. Kubota yearly items need the Kubota V1505 owner's manual (not in the club set yet).

oilfilter.name: Engine oil filter
oilfilter.desc: Spin-on. Pre-fill, oil the gasket, hand tight then a further 1/2 turn. Every 150 h with 4.6 L of 15W-40. The Notion manifest lists 108-3842 at 250 h: that is wrong.

aircleaner.name: Air cleaner
aircleaner.desc: Single element, no safety element. Replace (do not clean) every 100 h; check daily. Housing is 106-5277.

fuelsep.name: Fuel filter / water separator
fuelsep.desc: Spin-on canister 110-9049 on separator 110-9044. Replace every 400 h, then bleed the fuel system. Check fuel lines and connections at the same time.

belt.name: Fan / alternator belt
belt.desc: Check condition and tension every 100 h; replace on condition.

cooling.name: Radiator, oil cooler and thermostat
cooling.desc: 5.5 L of 50/50 water and ethylene glycol. Check the level cold daily, hoses every 100 h. Clean the radiator fins every 200 h with low-pressure air or water, engine cold. Check coolant strength yearly.

battery.name: Battery (12 V)
battery.desc: Charge at 3-4 A. Check cable connections every 50 h. A battery of matching size and CCA is fine.

pump.name: Spray pump (6-diaphragm)
pump.desc: Near the back of the tank. Grease the 2 remote fittings at the back of the machine every 50 h with Mobil XHP 461 only. Diaphragms and check valves inspected by the dealer every 400 h or yearly. Bulletin 08-20: use a 30-mesh suction screen for water-thin mixes; stainless heads 145-3399 go on as a set of 6, never mixed with old heads.

sprayfilters.name: Suction and pressure filters
sprayfilters.desc: Clean both daily (more often with wettable powders); replace the screens every 400 h. Suction 50 mesh 100-8642 standard (30 mesh 100-6991 cuts pump cavitation with thin mixes). Pressure 50 mesh 133-0385. Check the bowl and drain-plug O-rings at each clean.

valves.name: Valve manifolds, flow meter and agitation
valves.desc: Inspect the valve O-rings every 400 h (repair kit 130-7304). Clean the flow meter every 200 h or yearly: the turbine must spin freely. If the flow meter is replaced the InfoCenter software must be Rev E or later (bulletin 08-26).

gearbox.name: Rear planetary gearboxes
gearbox.desc: SAE 85W-140 gear lube, fill to the lower hole. Change every 400 h (quantity not stated in the manual).

nozzle.name: Nozzle turret and drip check
nozzle.desc: Turret bodies 108-3725 (LH single), 108-3726 (RH single), 108-3727 (double). Replace the 41003 diaphragm when a nozzle drips after shut-off. Tips are the club's choice: confirm on the machine.

tipstrainer.name: Nozzle tip strainer
tipstrainer.desc: Match mesh to nozzle size per the manual tables: 50 mesh for most tips, 100 mesh for fine tips.

suction.name: Suction filter
suction.desc: Clean daily, replace the screen every 400 h. 50 mesh blue is standard; 30 mesh green for water-thin mixes (bulletin 08-20); 80 mesh red.

pressure.name: Pressure filter
pressure.desc: Clean daily, replace the screen every 400 h. 30, 50, 80 or 100 mesh. Check the bowl and drain-plug O-rings.

pumphead.name: Spray pump diaphragms and heads
pumphead.desc: Repair kit has 6 diaphragms, 6 discs, 12 valves and 12 O-rings. Grease with Mobil XHP 461 only. Stainless heads 145-3399 are a set of 6.

flowmeter.name: Flow meter
flowmeter.desc: Clean every 200 h or yearly. A replacement needs InfoCenter software Rev E or later.

agitation.name: Agitation nozzles
agitation.desc: Four agitation nozzle assemblies in the tank. Set the agitation bypass to 689 kPa (100 psi) yearly.

110-9044.name: Fuel/water separator assembly
110-9044.note: Head for the 110-9049 canister. Only needed if damaged.

93-2242.name: Hydraulic filter and head assembly (x2)
93-2242.note: Order the 75-1310 element for services. Club stock shows one at $233.33.

132-7619.name: Fuel sender
132-7619.note: From the fuel tank page of PC 3415-480.

100-6991.name: Suction filter screen 30 mesh (green)
100-6991.note: Bulletin 08-20 recommends it for water-thin mixes.

145-3399.name: Stainless pump head service kit (6 heads)
145-3399.note: Bulletin 08-20: fit all 6 at once; do not mix with old heads.

132-7768.name: Spray pump, 6-diaphragm (original)
132-7768.note: Original pump. Bulletin 08-20 replacement with stainless heads is 136-2254.

108-3725.name: Nozzle turret body, LH single
108-3725.note: Confirm on the machine before ordering.

108-3726.name: Nozzle turret body, RH single
108-3726.note: Confirm on the machine before ordering.

108-3727.name: Nozzle turret body, double
108-3727.note: Confirm on the machine before ordering.

127-1100.name: Front wheel and tyre assembly
127-1100.note: Check the tyre fitted before ordering.

136-2300.name: Rear wheel and tyre assembly
136-2300.note: Check the tyre fitted before ordering.

108-3841: Toro dealer (Amacron / GA Power Equipment Spares / Emmetts)
108-3810: Air filter element (single element, no safety element)
75-1310: Hydraulic filter element (x2: under tank + rear frame)
106-5190: Toro dealer or battery specialist (match size/CCA)
133-2885: Spray pump repair kit (6 diaphragms, 6 diaphragm discs, 12 valves, 12 O-rings)
136-2254: Replacement spray pump with stainless heads (MP5800)

model.note: Part outlines on the photo are drawn by hand and approximate; the engine, spray pump, filters and valves sit under the tank and body and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from parts book 3415-480, operator's manual 3409-654 Rev E and Toro bulletins 08-20 and 08-26. The photo is Toro's studio shot of the petrol 5800-G, which shares the body, tank and booms with this diesel 41393 (s/n 403330615): quote the s/n when ordering.
